description: This line plot illustrates the comparative time cost in seconds for two different methods of paper retrieval as a function of the number of papers, ranging from 1 to 256 on a logarithmic scale. The x-axis is labeled “Paper Number” and uses a logarithmic scale with tick marks at regular intervals of 2 (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256). The y-axis is labeled “Time Cost (s)” and spans from 0 to 35 seconds. The plot displays two lines: a blue line with circular markers representing “w/o Pre-computation,” which starts at approximately 0.5 seconds when Paper Number is 1 and rises sharply to about 35 seconds at Paper Number 256, showing a steep, exponential increase; and an orange line with square markers representing “w Pre-computation,” which remains nearly constant at approximately 0.5 seconds across the entire range of paper numbers from 1 to 256.
